steps.code:
vis_res = primitives.call(
    name="observe_robotwin2_visual",
    camera_name="head_camera",
    prompt="Set the palm-sized bell on the dark brown displaystand.",
    query="bell and displaystand",
)
print("vis_res ok:", vis_res.ok)
handles = []
if vis_res.ok and "evidence_handle" in vis_res.output:
    handles.append(vis_res.output["evidence_handle"])

m_bell = primitives.call(
    name="measure_robotwin2_actor_visual",
    actor_label="050_bell",
    camera_name="head_camera",
    prompt="measure bell",
)
print("m_bell ok:", m_bell.ok)
if m_bell.ok and "evidence_handle" in m_bell.output:
    handles.append(m_bell.output["evidence_handle"])

m_stand = primitives.call(
    name="measure_robotwin2_actor_visual",
    actor_label="074_displaystand",
    camera_name="head_camera",
    prompt="measure displaystand",
)
print("m_stand ok:", m_stand.ok)
if m_stand.ok and "evidence_handle" in m_stand.output:
    handles.append(m_stand.output["evidence_handle"])

print("handles:", handles)

pp_res = primitives.call(
    name="execute_robotwin2_pick_place",
    arm_tag="right",
    evidence_handles=handles,
    source_actor_label="050_bell",
    target_actor_label="074_displaystand",
    pre_grasp_distance=0.08,
    lift_distance=0.1,
    pre_place_distance=0.08,
)
print("pp_res ok:", pp_res.ok)
if pp_res.ok:
    print("pp_res keys:", list(pp_res.output.keys()))
    for k in ["status", "actor_evidence", "arm_poses", "error", "message"]:
        if k in pp_res.output:
            print(k, ":", pp_res.output[k])
else:
    print("pp_res error:", pp_res.output)

    if res.ok and isinstance(res.output, dict):

# Probe right arm motion plan to bell contact pose and stand functional pose
